vampire-attire.png.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: transparent PNG costume overlay for a live webcam; a highly realistic gothic vampire outfit worn by an invisible mannequin.
Primary request: A cinematic, finely tailored black Victorian vampire cape and waistcoat, like an elegant classic Dracula. Textured black wool and subtle black silk brocade, charcoal satin lapels, black silk cravat, small dark ruby clasps at each clavicle, very thin deep crimson piping along cape edges. A dramatic but believable swept standing collar curves outward behind the neck, with gently pointed tips. Dark charcoal lining with soft reflected light, NOT large red panels.
Composition: one perfectly frontal, symmetrical, headless and armless upper torso garment, shoulders to mid torso, centered, square canvas. Collar tips around 15% and 85% of canvas width and 15% from top. The transparent empty neck opening is centered at x=50%, at approximately y=30% from top. Shoulder line around 40% from top. Broad sloping shoulders, natural fabric drape and detailed folds descending to bottom edge. Garment fills about 90% width at shoulders/lower cape. Lower torso continues through bottom edge.
Lighting: soft neutral frontal studio illumination, subtle cool highlights, richly visible fabric details, convincing photographic material depth, no harsh directional shadow.
Background: genuine alpha transparency, including empty space where the neck and head would be. No backdrop, no checkerboard painted into image.
Constraints: ONLY CLOTHING. No person, no head, no hair, no skin, no mannequin surface, no hands, no arms crossed in front, no bats, no logos, no text, no watermark. Empty neck hole is transparent. No white shirt, no cartoon, no illustration, no vector shapes, no flat colored polygons. Original garment design.

scene-valley.png.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: far background plate for a layered cinematic virtual-camera scene.
Edit target: the supplied moonlit gothic castle balcony image.
Keep the exact wide 16:9 framing, moon position, stormy photographic sky, mountain silhouettes, lake/valley composition, cool moonlit color palette, and level horizon.
Remove ALL foreground balcony stonework, floor, columns, planters, ivy and railing. Remove the entire castle and its right-hand rocky outcrop and bridge. Fill all removed regions with a convincing continuous deep mountain valley, forested slopes, lake and atmospheric distance. The nearest bottom edge should be dark distant forest and valley, not a terrace.
Increase photographic material realism and subtle atmospheric depth; cinematic night location photography, not a painting or illustration.
No people, no castle, no near stonework, no bats, no lightning bolts, no text. This is a fully opaque clean far-distance environmental plate, with scenery extending to every edge.

scene-castle.png.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction.
Asset type: transparent mid-distance plate for a layered cinematic virtual-camera environment.
Edit target: supplied moonlit gothic castle scene.
Extract ONLY the complete castle on the right, its stone bridge at the right edge, and the rocky forested crag directly underneath it. Keep their exact position, size and silhouette in the original wide 16:9 canvas. The tall central castle spire remains around x=80% and extends near the top edge. The crag extends down to the bottom edge on the right; its irregular left edge meets the valley around the horizontal center at the lower half.
Every other part of the image must be genuinely alpha transparent: no sky, no moon, no distant mountains, no valley, no foreground terrace/railing/columns/ivy/planters. Preserve open transparency between spires and arches where the sky used to be.
Match the original cool moonlit photographic stonework and subtle warm window lights. Make the materials richly photographic and believable. No invented scenery on the empty left side, no background, no checkerboard pixels, no text, no border. Do NOT recenter or enlarge the extracted castle.

scene-terrace.png.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction.
Asset type: near foreground terrace plate for a layered cinematic virtual-camera environment.
Edit target: the supplied moonlit gothic castle balcony image.
Extract ONLY the nearest stone balcony: the wet flagstone floor along the bottom, the gothic balustrade/railing across the lower third, the ivy-covered near column at the far left edge, and the side stone posts/urns at the far right. Preserve their exact original positions, sizes, wide 16:9 framing, camera perspective and cool moonlit material lighting. Photographic aged stone, wet reflections, natural ivy.
Remove EVERYTHING behind that balcony: castle, bridge, mountain valley, forest, sky, moon, fog. All removed areas must be true alpha transparency, including the openings between the railing's stone arches. The center and upper two thirds must be completely transparent except for the very narrow edge columns/ivy. No haze over the empty center.
No backdrop, no black fill, no checkerboard pixels, no people, no text, no added props. This must register as an overlay on the original image without repositioning.

transformation-bat.png.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent photographic creature sprite for a cinematic vampire-to-bats transformation.
Primary request: one realistic black vampire bat in flight, seen straight from the front and slightly from below, wings fully outstretched horizontally. Make it look like a premium film VFX creature rendered with physically realistic detail, not an icon or cartoon.
Subject: compact dark furred body exactly centered, small fierce head with pointed ears, subtle deep ruby eyes, articulated long finger bones and delicate scalloped leathery wing membranes. The two wings must be spread symmetrically in a broad horizontal silhouette, with visible shoulders and joints so each wing can later be animated independently. Body vertical; feet and a small tail membrane below. No open mouth or oversized fangs.
Lighting/mood: restrained cool moonlight along the top edges of the wings and body, enough soft fill to read the ribbed membrane structure against a dark moonlit castle; subtle wine-black translucency in the thin membrane, charcoal fur. Natural material texture.
Composition: landscape canvas, the entire single bat fits inside with a 5 percent clear margin around every wingtip, no cast shadow, no ground. Body at exact horizontal center, wings occupy most of the image width.
Constraints: genuinely transparent background with alpha, no other bats, no environment, no text, no border, no glow cloud, no checkerboard painted into the image, no logo, no watermark. Photographic 3D realism.
